title: Clean Architecture & DTO Separation
subtitle: Layered & Maintainable Design
description: Decoupling Controllers, Services, Repositories, and Models. Utilizing dedicated DTO objects with AutoMapper to prevent data leaks and isolate business logic.

title: Transactional Integrity & Concurrency Control
subtitle: ACID & Concurrency Safety
description: Employing Database Transactions for atomic multi-table updates, Pessimistic Concurrency locking to prevent stock overselling, and Filtered Unique Indexes.

title: Background Services & Resilience Engineering
subtitle: Automated Expiry & Fault Tolerance
description: Implementing BackgroundService workers for automated reservation expiry and queue reclamation, paired with Polly Retry Policies for network resilience.

title: Real-Time Sync & Secure Integrations
subtitle: Instant Push Alerts & Webhooks
description: Broadcasting instant order updates to kitchen displays using SignalR Hubs, coupled with Stripe Webhooks, Idempotency checks, and HMAC-SHA256 protection.
